<function name="GetWide" parent="Panel" type="classfunc">
	<description>Returns the width of the panel.

See <page>Panel:GetTall</page> for the height of the panel. See also <page>Panel:GetSize</page> for a function that returns both.</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">width</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
